lines.character: 钱斯／园丁 / Chance the Gardner
lines.note: 钱斯多次说出的标志性对白（被权贵误读）；Wikiquote／IMDb quotes／片中字幕可核。

lines.text: 只要根没有断，一切都会好起来。
lines.en: As long as the roots are not severed, all is well.
lines.note: 园丁昌斯的「治国箴言」，被误读为智慧；IMDb quotes 可查。

lines.en: In a garden, growth has its season.
lines.note: 同段園藝哲学；IMDb quotes 可查。
